(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 15 Julai 2024.

"(b) melalui kad kredit, kad debit, kad caj, kad prabayar atau apa -apa bentuk

TRADEMARK ACT 2019

TRADEMARKS (COMPOUNDING OF OFFENCES) (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 136 of the Trademarks Act 2019
[Act 815], the Minister, with  the approval of the Public Prosecutor, makes the
following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1)  These regulations may be cited as the Trademarks (Compounding of
Offences) (Amendment) Regulations 2024.

(2)  These Regulations come into operation on 15 July 2024.

Amendment of regulation 5
2. The Trademarks (Compounding of  Offences) Regulations 2020
[P.U. (A) 252/2020 ], which are referred to as the "principal Regulations" in these
Regulations, are amended in regulation 5 by substituting for paragraph (b) the
following paragraph:

"(b) through credit card, debit card, charge card, prepaid card or any other forms
of electronic payment.".

Amendment of Second Schedule
3. The Second Schedule of the principal Regulations is amended—

(a) by substituting for Form PCD 2 the following form:
